title: User journey
subtitle: One trip through the lifecycle — phases left to right, rows are who holds the work. ✋ marks the four decisions only you make; everything else runs without you. Click any step for the skill behind it.

lanes.title: You
lanes.blurb: terminal & tracker — hands-on while shaping, absent while building

lanes.title: Attended sessions
lanes.blurb: interactive threads you can join whenever you like

lanes.title: Autonomous agents
lanes.blurb: subagents in worktrees — AFK-safe, outcomes flow back

nodes.title: Loose items surface
nodes.blurb: a bug mid-interview, an idea mid-build, a follow-up — or a ticket filed by hand

nodes.title: to-backlog: sweep → confirm → publish
nodes.blurb: work-typed, no readiness role, chat context carried — groom's intake

nodes.title: backlog groom → confirm ✋
nodes.blurb: gate 1 of 4 — the sweep proposes batches; nothing spawns until you approve

nodes.title: Bless readiness ✋
nodes.blurb: gate 2 of 4 — LGTM on the spec'd ticket, in a comment or the thread

nodes.title: Approve the split ✋
nodes.blurb: gate 3 of 4 — a spec may recommend one; only you trigger it

nodes.title: shape: the interview
nodes.blurb: one thread per confirmed batch — frontier rounds settle decisions; terms land in CONTEXT.md and ADRs

nodes.title: to-spec: the spec lands — automatic
nodes.blurb: diagram first, on the subject's ticket; the thread then watches for your comments

nodes.title: to-slices: born-shaped child slices
nodes.blurb: published in dependency order; the parent becomes the capstone — alive, undispatchable while children are open

nodes.title: research & prototype
nodes.blurb: cited dossiers and throwaway artifacts, dispatched via to-subagent — results re-enter the thread

nodes.title: backlog build — walk away
nodes.blurb: building is autonomous; your next required appearance is the merge decision

nodes.title: backlog fans out & babysits
nodes.blurb: one worktree-isolated subagent per ready ticket — edges clear, no open children

nodes.title: build: ticket → review-ready CR
nodes.blurb: implement (tdd / diagnosing-bugs) → verify-your-work → change request → adversarial-review → prove-your-work

nodes.title: Read the evidence
nodes.blurb: claims, the proof each passed, what wasn't verified — assembled because you weren't watching

nodes.title: Authorize the merge ✋
nodes.blurb: gate 4 of 4 — nothing merges itself, ever

nodes.title: merge-changes: merge, close, clean
nodes.blurb: merges the authorized change, closes its tickets, cleans worktrees and stacks

nodes.title: capstone: the whole gets checked
nodes.blurb: last slice closes → coverage check against the spec; gaps become new children and re-block it, a clean pass closes it

edges.label: when the spec recommends a split
shipped work sparks the next idea
